description: This file provides utility functions for handling brand colors, including validation, color manipulation (lighten/darken), contrast checking, and generating color maps for branding themes. It also exports a React hook for applying branding colors.

methods.name: fallBackHex
methods.description: Returns the input color if valid, otherwise returns a default brand color based on theme (dark or light).

methods.name: isValidHexCode
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid hex color code.

methods.name: getValidHEX
methods.description: Validates and returns a proper hex color string, or default if invalid.

methods.name: hexToRgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB object.

methods.name: rgbToHex
methods.description: Converts RGB values to a hex color string.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens a hex color by a given intensity.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens a hex color by a given intensity.

methods.name: normalizeHexCode
methods.description: Normalizes hex color codes, expanding 3-digit codes to 6-digit.

methods.name: createColorMap
methods.description: Generates a color palette with various shades based on a brand color.

methods.name: getWCAGContrastColor
methods.description: Determines whether black or white text has better contrast on a given background color.

methods.name: checkWCAGContrastColor
methods.description: Checks if the contrast ratio between background and target color meets WCAG standards.

methods.name: useGetBrandingColours
methods.description: React hook that creates a theme object with branding colors, applying contrast and color manipulations.
